errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по низходящ ред на големината им, започвайки от най-големия (жълт) и завършвайки с най-малкия (сив).
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are visually arranged in descending order of size, but this is incorrect. The sectors are not sorted by size. For example, moving clockwise from the top, the slice sizes are 17%, 30%, 2%, 41%, and 10%, which is not a descending order.
The description states that the labels are inside the sectors, but they are all located outside the circular area of the pie chart.

The chart has two blue sectors, one light blue (17%) and one dark blue (10%). Describing the dark blue one as 'синьо-тъмносин' (blue-dark blue) is awkward and unclear. It would be clearer to describe it simply as 'dark blue' ('тъмносин').
